truth_posts.original: The Board of The Kennedy Center today agreed, almost unanimously, to close the Building for Safety reasons, and so that it can begin the process of Reconstruction. The closing will take place immediately, however, the Renovation and Reconstruction, which is a very large and complex job, cannot begin until such time as the D.C. Circuit rules on the Board’s approved name. If the ruling is a negative one, which it should not be, and is not overturned by the U.S. Supreme Court, the Reconstruction and the Renovation of The Kennedy Center will not take place. The attorneys from the DOJ will ask for an expedited appeal. In the meantime, 17 Million Dollars, raised by President Trump, has been put into The Kennedy Center account to keep it afloat. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
truth_posts.translated: 肯尼迪中心董事会今天几乎一致同意出于安全原因关闭大楼，以便开始重建过程。关闭将立即进行，但是，装修和重建是一项非常庞大和复杂的工作，只有在华盛顿特区巡回法院对董事会批准的名称作出裁决后才能开始。如果裁定是否定的，则不应该是否定的，并且不会被推翻

The Board of The Kennedy Center has strongly voted to save it, and they know I’m the only one who can do so, because I have the ability to raise the money, and the ability to construct — that few others have.
